title: Nightscout follower
body:
I tried to use the source nightscout follow
Entered in my website every way I can think of, it wont pull the data.

Is there a specific format that it needs to be in?  Is there any other setting that needs to be on?

comments.body:
I came here today looking for just this information.

I know there is the NightWatch app, but it's dated (last updated 2016).

I've had limited success using NSClient and xDrip+, but it's really hit and miss at consistency with following a NightScout webpage.

Is there any way to do this strictly withing the xDrip+ client, without any other applications running in the background? Need to be able to do this on a Pixel 3.

Please install the latest nightly, it is a lot more tolerant with the formats for the nightscout follower URL.

@danielharrelson select data source for nightscout following and then there is a URL to enter of your nightscout site.

@jamorham, maybe I'm wrong... but when I tried to setup as Nightscout follower, it is very unintuitive.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d0ZuhiqqLOM

Using a Dexcom G5 + Spike to upload to Nightscout, just trying to get Android to follow. It appears as if xDrip+ wants to setup to be the receiver for the transmitter upon first boot.

Maybe @crizz6396 can comment if that's the same issue they're having.

I tried the latest nightly build.  First time that I lost data.  After installing the latest nightly build I lost like 8 hours of data from today.

I tried to use the nightscout follow.  I thought it was working because I got it to download 1 reading then it stopped
@danielharrelson The Nightscout following data source is now included in the Source Wizard (20th Feb nightly), select `Other` then you will see the option.
@jamorham PERFECT! Thank you so much! I know I didn't open this ticket, but maybe @crizz6396 can comment too and it can be closed! :)

So it is working but poorly.  As soon. As I switch over to night scout follow and it downloads the data, it clears al but the last 12 hours.  I downloads 1 data point then doesn't pull again.  

I have to restart collector then it will download another data point.
To be honest, I'm the diabetic. My girlfriend follows me...She's got a Pixel 3XL with the latest Android, however she's currently asleep, so I'll check in tomorrow if there are any issues on my end.
Everything seems good on my end, sorry for late update. Can be closed for me.

Dan
You are using the follow sources and it updates without issue?
